internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 10:28 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Diagnosis confirmed that the root cause was resource exhaustion, specifically very high CPU utilization at 98%, causing increased p95 latency to 1.8 seconds. Other hypotheses such as memory leak and error injection were refuted based on low memory growth and low error rates.

Actions taken included disabling the adHighCpu flag at 10:48 UTC, which led to a verified recovery with latency dropping back to normal levels (0.12 seconds p95).

Timeline:
- 10:28:49 Alert received
- 10:48:33 Diagnosis confirmed CPU resource exhaustion
- 10:48:39 Flag disabled to mitigate issue
- 10:48:39 Recovery verified with latency normalization

The incident is now resolved. Further monitoring will continue to prevent recurrence.
